title: West Pakistan Board of Revenue Act and the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act Extension of the Tribal Areas of the Province of Baluchistan Regulation 1973

ACT (EXTENSION OF THE TRIBAL AREAS OF THE PROVINCE OF BA
WEST PAKISTAN BOARD OF REVENUE
ACT AND THE WEST PAKISTAN LAND REVENUE ACT (EXTENSION OF THE TRIBAL AREAS OF
THE PROVINCE OF BALUCHISTAN) REGULATION, 1973
1. Short title, extent
and commencement.‑This Regulation may be called the West Pakistan
Board of Revenue Act and the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act (Extension to the
Tribal Areas of the Province of Baluchistan) Regulation, 1973.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the Tribal Areas of the Province or Baluchistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

WEST PAKISTAN BOARD OF REVENUE
ACT AND THE WEST PAKISTAN LAND REVENUE ACT (EXTENSION OF THE TRIBAL AREAS OF
THE PROVINCE OF BALUCHISTAN) REGULATION, 1973
2. Extension of
West Pakistan Act XI of 1957 and Act X
VII of 1967, to‑ Tribal Areas
of the Province of Baluchistan.‑The
West Pakistan Board of Revenue Act, 1957 and the West Pakistan Land Revenue
Act, 1967, and so far as may be, all rules, notifications, orders and
instructions made or issued from time to time thereunder, shall extend to the
Tribal Areas of the Province of Baluchistan.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Board of Revenue Act and the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act Extension of the Tribal Areas of the Province of Baluchistan Regulation 1973
sections.description:

WEST PAKISTAN BOARD OF REVENUE
ACT AND THE WEST PAKISTAN LAND REVENUE ACT (EXTENSION OF THE TRIBAL AREAS OF
THE PROVINCE OF BALUCHISTAN) REGULATION, 1973
3. Repeal and savings.‑(1) The Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1887
(Act XVII of 1887), as applicable to the `tribal Areas of the Province of
Baluchistan hereinafter referred to as the said Act, is hereby repealed.
(2) Notwithstanding the repeal of the said Act‑
(a) all rules, appointments and transfers made,
notifications and proclamations issued, authorities and powers conferred, farms
and leases granted, records‑of‑rights and other records framed,
revised or confirmed. rights acquired. liabilities incurred, times and places
appointed, and other things done, under the said Act shall if not inconsistent
with the provisions of the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967, be continued
and, so far as may be, be deemed to have been respectively made, issued,
conferred, . granted, incurred, appointed and done under the latter Act; and
(b) all assessments of land revenue duly made,
approved or confirmed under the provisions of the said Act and in force
immediately before its ‑repeal shall continue, and subject to the
provisions of the West Pakistan Land
Revenue Act, 1967 remain in force until assessments made, approved:" or
confirmed under the provisions of the latter Act take effect.
